We examine the impact of the change of codes parameters and the order of constituent codes on turbo performance.
summary:
1. 为考察高码率量子纠错的迭代增益，作者以稳定子码构造乘积型量子分块涡轮码，在退极化信道下模拟软信息交换译码并分析复杂度。
2. 所得码率约为0.2，所测编码中更多逻辑比特增强迭代增益，较大分量码置于内层可降低单次迭代开销，但通常收敛更慢。
3. 分量码排序可用于权衡收敛速度与计算成本，但精确译码仍随分量码规模指数增长，候选截断有望缓解这一限制，其精度代价尚待量化。

title: Attainable and unattainable quantum precision limits in ultrastrong light--matter coupling
abstract: In this paper, we study the gauge dependence of quantum precision in ultrastrongly coupled light--matter systems. The unitary between gauges carries the coupling $g$, so each truncation defines a different family. The quantum Fisher information traces an exact parabola across frames. Harmonic matter minimizes it at a universal $\theta_\ast=\Omega/(\Omega+\omega)$, set by the matter and cavity frequencies. Only the minimal-coupling bound is attainable. Frames differ by a factor $9.6$ with opposite trends. Diverging virtual-excitation gain at the Dicke point is a gauge artifact and saturates.
summary:
1. 针对超强光物质耦合中估参界限的规范歧义，作者结合解析推导与四类势阱的精确对角化，研究单模基态的量子费舍尔信息。
2. 信息量沿表象插值呈精确抛物线，两规范结果之比最高达9.6，而在最小耦合表象固定测量的前提下，可达界限由该表象给出。
3. 对所考察的Dicke临界计量方案，规范一致化使静态信息量由发散转为饱和，提示虚激发增益须审慎核查，多模与开放系统仍待研究。

title: Singularising quantum channels preserving kappa-additivity
abstract: We construct quantum channels by averaging unitary shift conjugations with respect to $\kappa$-additive probability measures on measurable abelian groups. The channels act on the duals of operator algebras generated by shifts and bounded measurable multiplication operators. They preserve $\kappa$-additivity of quantum states and admit a weak-$*$ integral representation on this class. If the averaging measure vanishes on singletons, every output state is singular. In the appendix, we also establish the corresponding Fubini's theorem for $\kappa$-additive measures.
summary:
1. 针对量子态奇异化能否保留κ可加性，作者在加法联合可测的阿贝尔群上平均幺正平移共轭，于平移与有界可测乘法算子生成代数的对偶上构造信道。
2. 借助κ可加版富比尼定理，证明信道保持κ可加性并在这类态上具有弱星积分表示，且平均测度在单点上为零时所有输出均在紧算子上取零。
3. 该构造无需在全幂集上定义测度，但结论限于指定可观测量代数，保持同等可加性地延拓至整个有界算子代数仍待解决。

title: All-to-all connectivity via adiabatic ZZ interactions in a superconducting flux qubit processor
abstract: Scalable superconducting quantum processors would benefit from high qubit connectivity, yet existing architectures connect neighbouring qubits via tunable couplers, which introduce substantial wiring and control overhead. Here, we propose a baseband-driven adiabatic ZZ gate that entangles any selected pair in a register of flux qubits coupled via a common cavity. The qubits stay dc-biased at their flux sweet spot. Strong drives applied selectively through local flux lines, at frequencies far below the qubit transitions, adiabatically tilt the quantization axes and generate an effective longitudinal ZZ interaction. The strength of the coupling is tunable and controlled by the amplitudes and relative phase of the drives rather than by any resonance condition. Numerical simulations give coherent gate errors below $10^{-4}$ over broad ranges of drive frequency, with comparable fidelities for two simultaneous gates in a four-qubit register. The protocol is robust against frequency fluctuations and remains effective even when many qubits are coupled to the cavity.
summary:
1. 为实现任意比特对的选择性纠缠，作者在共腔磁通比特模型中解析推导并模拟低频绝热驱动诱导的ZZ门，直流偏置保持在磁通最佳工作点。
2. 无需跃迁共振，校正局域旋转后的55纳秒双比特门相干误差低于10⁻⁴，四比特中两门并行误差接近此量级。
3. 该机制为全连接及模块化扩展提供理论路径，但须避开旁带共振，且50微秒寿命下弛豫误差估计约10⁻³，仍待实验验证。

title: Long-Range Ergotropy Transfer with Weakened Boundary-Coupling Spin Chains
abstract: Ergotropy is a key quantity of a quantum battery that measures the maximum extractable energy. When the extraction process is not local, a faithful transfer of ergotropy across distance is necessary. In this work, we investigate such transfer by using spin chains with weakened coupling at the boundaries as mediator. Weakening the coupling at the two boundaries of the chain gives rise to localized edge states allowing high fidelity transfer within given time duration. We found that, for long spin chains, the transferred ergotropy alternates between even and odd number of spins. We explain this parity effect by investigating the chain spectral structure. Furthermore, we consider both the nearest-neighbor and long-range interactions between spin. In both model of interactions, weakening the boundary couplings improves the maximum transferred ergotropy for long spin chain, compared with in the case of conventional uniform chain. Although the long-range interaction reduces the transferred ergotropy, the transfer time is reduced, too, in particular for longer chain. In addition to the total transferred ergotropy, we also investigate the effect of initial states of the sender spin to the transport of the coherent and incoherent components of the total ergotropy, and the average transport efficiency.
summary:
1. 针对量子电池可提取功的远距离传输，作者在边界弱耦合XX自旋链中优化有限时间内的接收端可提取功，并用能谱及布洛赫矢量分析传输机制。
2. 所选初态下，弱耦合近邻链至100站点仍保留布居反转贡献，而均匀链超过12站点即失去该贡献，中心谱结构解释了长链的奇偶差异。
3. 边界调控为远程供能提供理论路径，但偶极长程耦合以降低最大接收端可提取功为代价缩短传输时间，实验性能仍待验证。

title: Reducing Provers in Distributed Quantum Verification
abstract: In the distributed quantum Merlin-Arthur ($\mathsf{dQMA}$) model introduced by Fraigniaud, Le Gall, Nishimura, and Paz (ITCS 2021), a network of quantum computers verifies a global property with the aid of a quantum proof supplied by an untrusted prover. While the nodes are computationally unbounded, the challenge is to limit proof size and the communication required for verification. In this paper, we consider the model of Hasegawa, Kundu, and Nishimura (PODC 2024), where the proof must be unentangled across nodes, and define its extension to $k$ unentangled provers, denoted by $\mathsf{dQMAS}(k)$. In this setting, we investigate the proof size per node and the communication costs of reducing the number of provers. Our first result reduces the number of provers from $k$ to two, doubling the proof size without additional communication. Moreover, with four additional rounds, we can reduce the number of provers from $k$ to one, using at most three times the original local proof size plus a logarithmic term in the number of nodes. Finally, we establish amplification for perfectly complete protocols. In this regime, a single prover suffices with a constant-factor overhead in our reductions, yielding $\mathsf{dQMAS} = \mathsf{dQMAS}(k)$.
summary:
1. 针对减少量子网络验证中互不纠缠证明者的资源代价，作者在跨节点可分离证明模型中，结合顺序SWAP测试与两跳路由构造归约。
2. 将多个证明者减至一个仅增加四轮通信，单节点证明由p增至3p+O(log N)，保持完备性但减弱健全性，其中N为节点数。
3. 借助可分离接受算符上界，完美完备时可指数压低误接受率并确立单、多证明者等价，而允许跨节点纠缠证明的推广仍待解决。

title: Effective Time Advance of Quantum Clocks under Postselection
abstract: In the familiar twin paradox, the traveling twin ages less than the one who stays behind as a consequence of relativistic time dilation. Here, we show that quantum postselection can effectively reverse this outcome. Using an analytically solvable quantum clock model, we demonstrate that postselection of the center-of-mass motion produces an effective time advance through anomalous weak values, even though every individual motional branch undergoes ordinary time dilation. We extend this analysis to a weak gravitational field and show that an effective time advance can arise even for simple coherent states of the quantum clock motion. We further illustrate this effect using a hydrogen-like atom, revealing how it manifests itself in the atomic wavefunction. Our results demonstrate that quantum interference and postselection can produce an effective time advance beyond conventional relativistic time dilation.
summary:
1. 为检验后选择能否改变量子钟的相对论读时，作者用二能级钟模型与拉姆齐干涉解析研究质心后选择，并纳入弱引力场。
2. 异常弱值可使条件读时超前于静止参考钟，而各运动分支仍遵循通常的时间膨胀；简单相干态也能产生此效应，类氢模型中则表现为偶极振荡的相位超前。
3. 原子钟干涉有望检验该条件效应，但需兼顾后选择成功率与条纹对比度，并评估低阶相对论修正及引力势二次近似的适用范围。

title: Quantum Robustness via Sandwiched Rényi Divergences
abstract: If a quantum state is known only approximately, how much can the expectation of an observable change? We answer with the worst-case expectation over all states within a sandwiched Rényi divergence budget of a reference state, for every order $\alpha \in [1/2,\infty]$. Convex duality gives this value as a one-dimensional optimization over a sandwiched Schatten norm, running from a fidelity risk at $\alpha = 1/2$, through the entropic risk at $\alpha = 1$, to a quantum conditional value-at-risk at $\alpha = \infty$. The main result is a classicalization theorem: the quantum problem coincides with the classical one for a probability measure $\omega_\alpha$ on the spectral interval of the observable, constructed from Heinävaara's tracial joint spectral measure and given by Stahl's theorem at $\alpha = 1$. The Hoeffding, Bernstein and Markov--Krein bounds of classical probability thereby apply to the quantum problem, and yield Pinsker-type inequalities with Bernstein-type refinements. The measure $\omega_\alpha$ is the Born measure only at $\alpha = 1/2$; for $\alpha > 1/2$, noncommutativity of the observable with the state strictly lowers its variance below the Born variance, and with it every variance-sensitive bound: a quantum deflation.
summary:
1. 为量化态不确定性引起的可观测量期望偏移，作者在有限维满秩参考态上，以夹心Rényi散度限定不确定性，并用凸对偶将最坏期望化为一维优化。
2. 对全部α∈[1/2,∞]，量子问题与特定谱测度的经典优化精确等价，且α>1/2时非对易性使该测度的方差严格低于玻恩方差，并在α=1给出Bernstein型Pinsker改进。
3. 该框架可将态置信域转化为可观测量误差保证，但多体体系中改进幅度的尺度规律及无限维推广仍待研究。

title: $\mathsf{EQP}\subseteq\mathsf{IP}$ Does Not Relativize
abstract: We construct a recursive oracle $O$ and a unary language $L\in\mathsf{EQP}^O\setminus(\mathsf{IP}^O\cup\mathsf{PH}^O)$, strengthening the $\mathsf{BQP}$ versus $\mathsf{IP}$ oracle separation of Bouland et al. to exact quantum computation. The separation is based on a variant of the Forrelation problem in which the normalized correlation of one Boolean function with the Fourier transform of another is promised to be exactly $+1/2$ or $-1/2$. The main technical contribution is a repair method that constructs distributions supported on these exact levels while preserving the indistinguishability needed for the $\mathsf{IP}$ and $\mathsf{PH}$ lower bounds. A uniform polynomial-time quantum algorithm distinguishes the two cases with certainty using only three oracle queries.
summary:
1. 针对精确量子计算的经典交互验证界限，作者通过傅里叶关联分布的分箱计数修复与对角化，构造可计算的共享预言机。
2. 修复将关联值严格固定为±1/2并保持经典不可区分性，使所得一元语言可由统一多项式时间量子算法用三次查询精确判定，却不属于同一预言机下的交互证明类IP或多项式层级PH。
3. 该结果表明EQP⊆IP的证明必须超越相对化方法，但不否定无预言机时已成立的包含关系。

title: Self-Energy Construction for Chain Representations of Open Quantum Systems
abstract: We identify the self-energy as the environmental response to the system, which transforms covariantly under shifts of the system--environment cut. For a semi-infinite chain with asymptotically uniform parameters, this transformation admits a fixed point that defines the asymptotic boundary self-energy (BSE), whose spectral density is the Wigner semicircle. A chain-extended BSE exploits the trend of the retained chain, offering improved accuracy in representing the environment. The transformation introduces a pseudo-hyperbolic self-energy distance that is invariant under shifts of the cut, providing a natural geometry for comparing environmental responses. As a demonstration, this geometry enables cut-independent error measure of finite damped-oscillator closures of the chain, distinguishing the closure error from the chain depth error, and offers a more accurate fitting scheme than fitting the time-domain correlation function.
summary:
1. 为控制开放系统的环境截断误差，作者利用量子比特—振子链的自能连分式，构造对应半圆谱的渐近边界自能及链趋势修正。
2. 实频轴上沿无损链传播的伪双曲距离不随划分移动，可区分闭合与深度误差，其拟合使基准中十模闭合误差由1.1×10⁻²降至2.9×10⁻⁴。
3. 已知链系数及渐近尾部时可不依赖显式谱密度构造闭合，但趋势修正依赖系数的收敛形式，多激发动力学仍待检验。

title: A short proof of the Aaronson-Ambainis Conjecture via the completion framework
abstract: We give a short proof of the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture. If a partial Boolean function $f$ is defined on a $\delta$-fraction of all $n$-bit strings and have quantum query complexity $Q(f)$, then, for every $0<\epsilon<1$, a deterministic algorithm computes $f$ correctly on at least a $1-\epsilon$ fraction of its domain using $O( Q(f)^6 / (\epsilon \delta)^2)$ queries. Our proof uses the completion framework and establishes a more general bound in terms of the classical adversary measure. The only result we use from Turturean's recent proof is a special case of his certificate inequality, for which we provide a self-contained proof. We also derive the stronger variant of the Aaronson-Ambainis Conjecture, the bounded-polynomial influence conjecture, from our main result in the appendix.
summary:
1. 针对量子查询能否在多数输入上被经典模拟，作者结合函数补全、经典对抗量与分数证书不等式，构造低查询复杂度的确定性决策树。
2. 对定义域密度为δ的部分布尔函数，O(Q(f)^6/(εδ)^2)次查询即可在域内均匀分布下达到至少1−ε的正确率，从而证明Aaronson–Ambainis猜想。
3. 附录还证明布尔立方体上有界d次多项式的最大坐标影响量具有Ω((v/d)^12)下界，其中v为方差，但这些结果不保证运行时间上的高效经典模拟。

title: GARI++: A General-Purpose Decoder for Quantum Error Correction
abstract: We present GARI++, a two-stage decoding pipeline achieving accuracy competitive with the state of the art across surface, bivariate bicycle and color codes without relying on ensembles. The first stage uses GARI, a normalized min-sum decoder with random serial scheduling on the GARI transformed matrix. The second stage decoder is used only for the cases that the first stage does not converge, and the decoder is configurable based on the choice of the QEC code. The first stage pipelines towards the second stage both the residual syndrome and the soft information. GARI++ pipelining is predictive, meaning that GARI++ chooses the first stage iteration outputs which are expected to deliver the best accuracy in the second stage. GARI++ motivates a hybrid FPGA-CPU architecture for real-time decoding. For example, under uniform circuit-level depolarising noise with a physical error rate of 0.001, the FPGA implementation of GARI achieves average latencies per round ranging from $201 ns$ to $11.8\mu s$ for surface code distances between 7 and 25. At the same time, due to the very low weight residuals output by the first stage, the average residual decoding time per round remains near constant and below one microsecond on a single Apple M2 core for surface code distances even up to 51 when using Union-Find and accuracy on par with correlated MWPM.
summary:
1. 为兼顾量子纠错译码精度与时延，作者提出GARI++两级流程，从归一化最小和迭代中预测性筛选残余综合征与软信息，仅对未收敛样本调用后级。
2. 在电路级均匀退极化噪声的Z存储模拟中，表面码至码距71达到相关匹配精度，双变量自行车码和色码也优于所用基准。
3. 表面码首级已在单FPGA实现至码距25，支持探索FPGA–CPU混合架构，但残余译码计时不含首级、准备及通信开销，端到端实时性仍待验证。

title: The hidden symmetry operators of the asymmetric quantum Rabi model and its two-photon and two-mode variants in closed form
abstract: The asymmetric quantum Rabi model, a two-level system with splitting $\Delta$ and bias $\epsilon$ coupled with strength $g$ to a boson mode, has level crossings when $\epsilon$ is an integer multiple $N$ of the mode frequency. They are due to a hidden symmetry operator $J$, for which no general formula has been available. Here we obtain $J$ in closed form for every $N$. We find that $J$ is given by the parity of the symmetric model times the continuant (ordered tridiagonal determinant) of $N$ first-order operators, which are the Hamiltonians at the intermediate biases $N-1,N-3,\dots,1-N$ minus a common number operator. The symmetry is thus a staircase of $N$ bias steps that closes on the mirror image of the model precisely at integer bias. The proof uses induction on two commutation relations. The same relations hold in the asymmetric two-photon and two-mode models, written with the generators of $\mathfrak{su}(1,1)$, so that the same continuant gives their symmetry operators for every order, previously known only for the lowest ones. We also relate the closed formula for $J$ to the known recursion relations for its coefficients and give their terms of lowest order in $\Delta$ explicitly.
summary:
1. 针对非对称量子拉比模型整数倍模频偏置下能级交叉的隐对称性，作者在位移玻色算符表象中利用对易关系归纳构造了其生成元。
2. 生成元为对称模型宇称与有序三对角行列式的乘积，以有限偏置阶梯连接镜像哈密顿量，并适用于双光子和双模模型在重整化频率偶数倍偏置下的任意阶数。
3. 该闭式为分析对称扇区和低能谱提供工具，但生成元平方对应多项式的一般形式及其与约束多项式的关系仍未解决。

title: Dephasing-Induced Melting of Crystalline Spectral Form Factors
abstract: Long-range spectral order can be probed using spectral form factors, where it manifests itself as sharp Bragg peaks at integer multiples of the Heisenberg time in nearly crystalline spectra. We examine how energy dephasing in open systems affects this spectral order and how to control it. We find that Bragg peaks fade algebraically with revival order and dephasing strength, $K_{\rm Bragg}(p)\propto(\gamma p)^{-1/2}$, within an extensive intermediate regime, and persist up to the lifetime of nearest-neighbor coherences despite an extreme decoherence rate. Our results establish the spectral form factor as a probe of spectral order in open quantum systems and identify temporal correlations in spectral fluctuations as a means of controlling it.
summary:
1. 作者结合能量退相位主方程的解析求解与β随机矩阵模拟，研究近等间距能谱的布拉格复现如何被环境噪声和内禀能级涨落共同抑制。
2. 理想谱的相干峰高在中间区间按(γp)⁻¹ᐟ²衰减，复现持续至最近邻相干寿命约1/γ，远超随希尔伯特空间维数平方缩短的初始退相干时间。
3. 模型中缩短谱涨落的关联时间可经运动窄化延长复现，扫描退相位强度还能区分谱序类型，但这些调控与诊断方案仍待实验检验。
